_note: The scripts a release-chain stage file may run (rule 66/67 grammar, advisor decision b, Oct 9): by path and sha256. Changing a listed script changes its hash: update the row in the same commit (python3 -c 'import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read()).hexdigest())' PATH). The text scan over listed scripts over-reports by design; `tools` lists the denied words a script may contain, `runs` the listed scripts it may start.

scripts.reason: the verifier; its `sign` subcommand is the provenance signer (it checks Build's record, then calls cosign attest-blob once); listed tools are subcommand and message words the text scan over-reports, not commands it runs
installs one pinned tool by checksum (curl downloads it, trap cleans the temp dir); it names gitsign as a tool it can install and signs nothing; the other listed words appear in its comments
the dry run's hostile Build step: signs forged material with this job's OWN Build identity (cosign sign-blob) only to prove Release refuses it; runs only when the dry run asks (if: inputs.hostile)
imported by chain-verify.py and chain_hostile.py: the refusal, base64, the openssl call, strict JSON and the clock
imported by chain-verify.py: the dry run's judges (one row per hostile attempt, the token and key grading, the verdict)
the one Witness wrapper (rule 68): fetches the identity token, runs witness once under timeout 540
Build, job apk: admission, the two apk builds with cache's script, the version checks, this architecture's items fragment
Build, job assemble: verify and bind the apk records, assemble both images and the archives, write digests.json and items.json
Rebuild, job rapk: verify Build's record, rebuild the apks, write the fragment
Rebuild, job rebuild: verify both records, rebuild the images and archives, compare every item with Build's
Build admission: every check of the former stage-admission.yml, policy from origin/main, GET-only API calls through gh
the version, revision and clean-tree check of a built binary or apk
the four Linux archives from the apks (PROPOSED layout)
bind, items-apk, items-merge, rebuild-compare and record-env: the items of Build and Rebuild (imported by bin/chain-verify.py)
